description: Change a group's people, as its settings do — only its administrators may: 'add' puts colleagues in, 'admins' and 'notAdmins' make members administrators or not, 'remove' takes people out. Your own username in 'remove' is leaving the group, which anybody may. 'title' renames it. Applied in that order — add, admins, notAdmins, title, remove — and stopped at the first refusal, which is named; what came before it stays done. A direct chat has no members to change; a project's chat is whoever may open the project.

add.description: Colleagues to add, by username or email.

admins.description: Members to make administrators, by username.

notAdmins.description: Administrators to make plain members, by username.

remove.description: Members to take out, by username. Your own is leaving.

title.description: A new title for the group.

name: set_chat_members
title: Set chat members
